## Setup

### Load packages

```{r}
library(here)
library(glue)
library(ggplot2)
library(fs)
library(tidyverse)
library(markov.misc)
library(arrow)
library(furrr)
library(memoise)

# Set up parallel processing
plan(multisession, workers = 8)
```

### Configuration

```{r}
DECISION_THRESHOLD <- 0.95

DATA_PATH <- here("3-survival", "sim-data")
OUTPUT_PATH <- here("3-survival", "output", "bayesian-power-sim")
```

### Define Scenarios

```{r}
# Calculate true RMST differences for each scenario
# Load datasets temporarily to calculate true effects
h0_data <- read_parquet(file.path(DATA_PATH, "h0_forward.parquet"))
ha_09_data <- read_parquet(file.path(DATA_PATH, "ha_09_forward.parquet"))
ha_08_data <- read_parquet(file.path(DATA_PATH, "ha_08_forward.parquet"))
ha_07_data <- read_parquet(file.path(DATA_PATH, "ha_07_forward.parquet"))
ha_06_data <- read_parquet(file.path(DATA_PATH, "ha_06_forward.parquet"))

true_rmst_h0 <- h0_data |>
  select(id, time = day, y, tx) |>
  calc_time_in_state_diff(target_state = 1:4) |> 
  pull(true_effect)

true_rmst_09 <- ha_09_data |>
  select(id, time = day, y, tx) |>
  calc_time_in_state_diff(target_state = 1:4) |> 
  pull(true_effect)

true_rmst_08 <- ha_08_data |>
  select(id, time = day, y, tx) |>
  calc_time_in_state_diff(target_state = 1:4) |> 
  pull(true_effect)

true_rmst_07 <- ha_07_data |>
  select(id, time = day, y, tx) |>
  calc_time_in_state_diff(target_state = 1:4) |> 
  pull(true_effect)

true_rmst_06 <- ha_06_data |>
  select(id, time = day, y, tx) |>
  calc_time_in_state_diff(target_state = 1:4) |> 
  pull(true_effect)

rm(h0_data, ha_09_data, ha_08_data, ha_07_data, ha_06_data)

# Define scenarios
scenarios <- tibble(
  scenario_type = c("H0", "HA", "HA", "HA", "HA"),
  effect_label = c("OR_1.0", "OR_0.9", "OR_0.8", "OR_0.7", "OR_0.6"),
  rmst_diff_true = c(true_rmst_h0, true_rmst_09, true_rmst_08, true_rmst_07, true_rmst_06),
  data_file = c("h0_forward.parquet", "ha_09_forward.parquet", 
                "ha_08_forward.parquet", "ha_07_forward.parquet", "ha_06_forward.parquet")
) |>
  mutate(
    data_path = file.path(DATA_PATH, data_file),
    scenario_label = glue("{scenario_type}_{effect_label}"),
    output_path = file.path(OUTPUT_PATH, scenario_label)
  )

scenarios
```

## Load Results

### Helper Functions

```{r}
#' Load and combine summary results from all iterations
#' 
#' @param output_path Path to scenario output directory
#' @return Combined tibble of all summary results
load_scenario_summaries <- function(output_path) {
  summary_dir <- file.path(output_path, "summary")
  
  if (!dir.exists(summary_dir)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  summary_files <- list.files(summary_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", 
                               recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(summary_files) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  map(summary_files, readRDS) |>
    list_rbind()
}

#' Load p_benefit values from details files
#' 
#' @param output_path Path to scenario output directory
#' @return Tibble with iter, analysis, and p_benefit
load_p_benefit <- function(output_path) {
  details_dir <- file.path(output_path, "details")
  
  if (!dir.exists(details_dir)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  details_files <- list.files(details_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", 
                               recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(details_files) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  map(details_files, function(f) {
    d <- readRDS(f)
    # Extract iteration from filename
    iter <- as.integer(gsub(".*_iter_(\\d+)\\.rds", "\\1", f))
    # Extract analysis from directory name
    analysis <- basename(dirname(f))
    
    # Handle different possible structures
    p_benefit <- if (is.list(d) && length(d) > 0 && !is.null(d[[1]]$p_benefit)) {
      d[[1]]$p_benefit
    } else if (!is.null(d$p_benefit)) {
      d$p_benefit
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
    
    tibble(
      iter = iter,
      analysis = analysis,
      p_benefit = p_benefit
    )
  }) |>
    list_rbind()
}

# Cache these functions for faster reloading
load_scenario_summaries_cached <- memoise(load_scenario_summaries)
load_p_benefit_cached <- memoise(load_p_benefit)
```

### Aggregate Results Across All Scenarios

```{r}
# Aggregate results for all scenarios (parallel processing)
all_results <- furrr::future_map(seq_len(nrow(scenarios)), function(i) {
  scenario <- scenarios[i, ]
  
  summaries <- load_scenario_summaries_cached(scenario$output_path)
  p_benefits <- load_p_benefit_cached(scenario$output_path)
  
  if (is.null(summaries)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Join p_benefit if available
  if (!is.null(p_benefits)) {
    summaries <- summaries |>
      left_join(p_benefits, by = c("iter", "analysis"))
  }
  
  summaries |>
    mutate(
      scenario_type = scenario$scenario_type,
      effect_label = scenario$effect_label,
      rmst_diff_true = scenario$rmst_diff_true,
      scenario_label = scenario$scenario_label
    )
}) |>
  list_rbind()

all_results
```

## Summarize Operating Characteristics

```{r}
#' Summarize Bayesian operating characteristics with jackknife MCSE
#' 
#' @param results Combined results from all iterations
#' @param decision_threshold P(benefit) threshold for declaring success
#' @return Summary tibble with power and MCSE
summarize_bayesian_oc <- function(results, decision_threshold = 0.95) {
  results |>
    group_by(scenario_type, effect_label, rmst_diff_true, 
             scenario_label, analysis, term) |>
    summarise(
      n_iters = n(),
      mean_estimate = mean(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_estimate = sd(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_sd_posterior = mean(std_error, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_p_benefit = mean(p_benefit, na.rm = TRUE),
      # Power/Type I error: proportion where P(benefit) > threshold
      power = mean(p_benefit > decision_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
      # Jackknife MCSE for power
      power_mcse = markov.misc::jackknife_mcse(
        p_benefit, 
        statistic = function(x) mean(x > decision_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      # Coverage: proportion where 95% CI includes 0
      coverage_includes_null = mean(conf_low <= 0 & conf_high >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# Generate summary
oc_summary <- summarize_bayesian_oc(
  all_results |> filter(!is.na(p_benefit)), 
  decision_threshold = DECISION_THRESHOLD
)

oc_summary |>
  select(scenario_type, effect_label, rmst_diff_true, analysis, 
         n_iters, mean_estimate, power, power_mcse)
```

## Visualize Results

### Power Curve by Effect Size

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

if (nrow(oc_summary) > 0) {
  # Create power curve plot
  power_plot <- oc_summary |>
    mutate(
      analysis_label = case_when(
        analysis == "surv_coef" ~ "Treatment Coefficient (log-HR)",
        analysis == "surv_rmst" ~ "RMST Difference",
        TRUE ~ analysis
      )
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = rmst_diff_true, y = power, color = analysis_label, 
               group = analysis_label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = pmax(0, power - 1.96 * power_mcse), 
          ymax = pmin(1, power + 1.96 * power_mcse)),
      width = 0.2,
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "gray80") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1),
      labels = scales::percent_format()
    ) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
    labs(
      title = "Bayesian Power by True RMST Difference and Analysis Method",
      subtitle = glue("Decision threshold: P(benefit) > {DECISION_THRESHOLD}; ",
                      "Error bars: 95% CI"),
      x = "True RMST Difference (Days)",
      y = "Power / Type I Error Rate",
      color = "Analysis Method",
      caption = paste0(
        "Dashed line = 5% Type I error target;\n",
        "Dotted line = 80% power target"
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  print(power_plot)
  
  # Save plot
  ggsave(
    file.path(OUTPUT_PATH, "power_curve_survival.svg"),
    power_plot,
    width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 150
  )
}
```

### Summary Table

```{r}
if (nrow(oc_summary) > 0) {
  # Create formatted summary table
  summary_table <- oc_summary |>
    mutate(
      power_formatted = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%%)", power * 100, power_mcse * 100),
      estimate_formatted = sprintf("%.3f (SD: %.3f)", mean_estimate, sd_estimate)
    ) |>
    select(
      Scenario = scenario_type,
      `Effect Label` = effect_label,
      `True RMST Diff` = rmst_diff_true,
      Analysis = analysis,
      N = n_iters,
      `Mean Estimate (SD)` = estimate_formatted,
      `Power/T1E (MCSE)` = power_formatted
    )
  
  summary_table |>
    knitr::kable(digits = 3)
  
  # Save summary
  arrow::write_parquet(
    oc_summary, 
    file.path(OUTPUT_PATH, "operating_characteristics_survival.parquet")
  )
}
```

## Detailed Results by Scenario

```{r}
if (nrow(oc_summary) > 0) {
  # Display results grouped by scenario
  oc_summary |>
    mutate(
      true_rmst_formatted = sprintf("%.2f days", rmst_diff_true),
      power_ci = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%%, %.1f%%)", 
                         power * 100,
                         pmax(0, power - 1.96 * power_mcse) * 100,
                         pmin(1, power + 1.96 * power_mcse) * 100)
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(mean_estimate)) |> 
    select(
      `Scenario` = scenario_label,
      `True RMST` = true_rmst_formatted,
      `Analysis` = analysis,
      `N` = n_iters,
      `Mean Est` = mean_estimate,
      `SD Est` = sd_estimate,
      `Power (95% CI)` = power_ci
    ) |>
    knitr::kable(digits = 3)
}
```

## Posterior Distribution Analysis (Optional)

```{r}
#| eval: false

#' Load posterior draws for detailed analysis
load_posterior_draws <- function(output_path) {
  details_dir <- file.path(output_path, "details")
  
  if (!dir.exists(details_dir)) return(NULL)
  
  details_files <- list.files(details_dir, pattern = "\\.rds$", 
                               recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  
  map(details_files, function(f) {
    d <- readRDS(f)
    if (is.list(d) && length(d) > 0 && !is.null(d[[1]]$posterior_draws)) {
      d[[1]]$posterior_draws
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  }) |>
    list_rbind()
}

# Example: Load and plot posterior draws for one scenario
if (nrow(scenarios) > 0) {
  example_scenario <- scenarios$output_path[2]  # HA_OR_0.9
  draws <- load_posterior_draws(example_scenario)
  
  if (!is.null(draws) && nrow(draws) > 0) {
    draws |>
    #   filter(iter <= 10) |>  # First 10 iterations for clarity
      ggplot(aes(x = tx_effect, color = analysis)) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
    #   facet_wrap(~iter, scales = "free_y") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      labs(
        title = "Posterior Distributions of Treatment Effect",
        x = "Treatment Effect (log-HR for surv_coef, RMST diff for surv_rmst)",
        y = "Density"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
  }
}
```
